name: BELGRAVIA
title: An elegant life, in ivory.
tagline: Walnut burl. Ivory lacquer. Gilded detail.
description: Twenty-two distinct MARINER references inhabit an arched-window salon, a walnut dining room, a soft ivory bedroom and a classical office. Dark walnut burl, white lacquer, sycamore-tone marquetry, carved gilt columns and faceted diamond aprons follow the supplied BELGRAVIA pages. Crystal lighting, pleated curtains, panel mouldings and pale textiles interpret the original room compositions. The connected plan, unseen construction and exact finish calibration remain authored interpretations, not certified manufacturer CAD or a measured source building.
finish: BEL. / OF (488/55); high-back stool BEL. (488); ornate mirror POE. (380)
